text.content:
name: fixture-family
nodes:
  primary:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
  secondary:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
content:
  payload:
    type: file
    target: primary
    path: ${payload_path}
variables:
  payload_path:
    type: string
    allowed_values:
    - /opt/a
    - /opt/b
variation_points:
  payload-path:
    kind: parameter
    target:
      kind: variable
      variable: payload_path
    domain:
      kind: enum
      values:
      - /opt/a
      - /opt/b
  payload-host:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: reference
      owner: payload
      slot: content.target
    alternatives:
      primary-host:
        reference: primary
      secondary-host:
        reference: secondary
